inlines.v: SCAP'ULAR, adjective [Latin scapularis.] Pertaining to the shoulder, or to the scapula; as the scapular arteries. SCAP'ULAR, noun [supra.] 1. In anatomy, the name of two pairs of arteries, and as many veins. 2. In ornithology, a feather which springs from the shoulder of the wing, and lies along the side of the back.
